question: In Derek Walcott's 'Omeros', the character of Achille's journey to Africa primarily serves to explore which thematic concern?

The psychological and cultural alienation of the Caribbean diaspora
A literal representation of the Middle Passage as historical fact
The superiority of African civilization over European modernity

Multiple first-person narrators that destabilize a single authoritative truth

The use of dense, mythic, non-linear prose that dissolves boundaries between life and death
An exclusively dialogue-driven narrative with minimal description
